title: Honest Boundary Precision for ATE under Complete-Case Missing at Random
banked_reason: Validity-gate-confirmed terminal:laundering: all-face computation and simultaneous attainment remain open; promised sharp connected-game certificates and data-only original-record attainment were moved into OEQs. Supporting derivative certificate survives independent audit.
gap_reasons: The novel compatibility geometry and equality/strictness criterion are usefully positioned, but the promised headline object is only an unevaluated connected-kernel infimum with nonmatching analytic bounds: no shrinking certified full-game value, strong duality, all-mean tail repair, or finite termination procedure is delivered.

The promised data-only uniformly honest original-record interval and attained adaptation factor are explicitly unresolved; the coarse Wald fallback is usable but does not deliver the advertised full-record boundary-precision procedure at strict-gain anchors.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery established compatibility and tangent/lineality geometry, an inherited Gaussian shortening classification, a verified strict-gain analytic witness bracket, and a coarse honest fallback; eleven cited leaves were source-attested with explicit edition/provenance corrections. The promised shrinking full-game certificates and uniformly honest unknown-face original-record attainment with exact adaptation factor remained open, and an independent validity gate confirmed terminal structural kernel substitution rather than a scoped repair. No formalization stage ran and no Lean module or kernel-checked headline theorem was produced; the supporting derivative objection was independently refuted and is not the reason for failure.
tldr: Complete-case MAR identifies the ATE, while complementary incomplete confounder records constrain the retained observed law. The proposal characterizes compatibility for every finite pair of alphabets and classifies honest boundary precision on the complete one-sided cone. Its main open content is executable sharp connected-interval certification and the exact adaptation factor of one uniformly honest original-record procedure. Public cell and pattern floors are maintained finite EHR cohort restrictions. Compatibility, identification and coarse fallback inference persist without incomplete-pattern floors; sharp benchmarks have a positive original-category anchor domain. Interior gradient equivalence and inherited single-cut shortening support the kernel; all-face computation and simultaneous attainment remain open.
gap: Levis et al., Section 7, leaves the retained nonmonotone CCMAR restrictions unresolved. Restricted-normal and convex-class expected-measure results supply decision machinery but do not establish this connected, lineality-equivariant boundary objective or its unknown-face table transfer.
fill: Observable all-face geometry and an honest gain criterion support sharp finite certificate and original-record adaptation questions. A solution must deliver independently checked brackets, full-mean and covariance error control, and an attained adaptation factor rather than an equality-face variance calculation.
